profiles.name: Assurance and oversight compromise
profiles.mechanism: Forged completion, altered grader/monitor, selective omission or misleading process evidence.
profiles.test: Compare reported success to protected observation; include contaminated grading and a legitimate result.

profiles.name: Unsafe authorized execution
profiles.mechanism: Valid identity and scope with stale conditions, wrong target, repeated commitment or unmet postcondition.
profiles.test: Change environment, state or target after approval and exercise timeout-after-commit.

profiles.name: Human-agent trust exploitation
profiles.mechanism: Manipulation of evidence, framing, consent, apparent consensus or relational trust leading to an unintended approval.
profiles.test: Present correlated evidence and an expanded action under realistic decision conditions; observe comprehension and intervention.
